The '''Skirmish on the Alien Construct''' was a battle fought between the crew of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] allied to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] and led by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]] aboard an [[alien construct]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
